summary: Section 46B Share Rewards / Embajador Bronze: 12/12 backend pytest pass + full UI lifecycle (locked→eligible→claim+toast+confetti→claimed) verified live in browser. All 17 review-request checkpoints covered.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: <span> rendered inside <option> in US_STATES <select> (ProviderDashboard.jsx:387). Not introduced by Section 46B — flagging for future cleanup.

critical_code_review_comments: claim_share_reward in server.py is ~80 lines — consider extracting _extend_subscription helper for unit testability, but not blocking.

Subscription `amount: 0` is set to 0 unconditionally on reward claim; if billing later reads this, it should be revisited to preserve prior amount (current behavior matches review request acceptance criteria, just a future-billing note).
ShareRewardsCard `if (loading || !data) return null` silently hides the card when the GET fails (e.g. 404 'Sin perfil') — intentional and graceful, no action needed.
Unique index db.share_reward_claims [(user_id, tier_id)] correctly enforces idempotency at DB layer (DuplicateKeyError caught → 400).
seed_data_creation: Tests mutate provider_profiles.share_count / referred_view_count and subscriptions.next_renewal_date for demo provider. On teardown, hand-off state left as: share_count=24, referred_view_count=16, claims=0 (eligible), subscription plan=pro, next_renewal_date=now+365d.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests env: must set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL when running pytest (e.g. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://verified-providers-2.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iter47_share_rewards.py). After full UI test the provider is now in CLAIMED state (claimed during UI playwright run). To re-run the UI test, delete the claim via mongo: db.share_reward_claims.delete_many({'user_id':'user_3e47ee2b3526','tier_id':'embajador_bronze'}).
